G L E U H R
Wellness Pvt Ltd
RECEPTIONIST
Training Framework  ·  6–8 days at Chandigarh HQ (3 classroom + 3–5 live)
Structured across three streams — Front Desk Foundations, Appointments & Hospitality, Billing & Live Practical
How This Training Works
Every Receptionist goes through this programme at Chandigarh before being deployed to a clinic. The programme runs 6 to 8 days — the first three classroom, the remaining three to five live at the front desk. Sign-off comes from every trainer plus a final readiness test — running the front desk solo for two to three consecutive days.
Three streams
STREAM 1 — Front Desk Foundations. Grooming, professionalism, communication and discipline. Owned by the Senior Receptionist and the Front Desk Manager.
STREAM 2 — Appointments, Calls & Hospitality. Booking SOP, call and WhatsApp handling, hospitality and flow. Owned by the Senior Receptionist and the FDM.
STREAM 3 — Billing, Records & Live Practical. Transparent billing, CRM and records, complaint handling and live front-desk work. Owned by the Senior Receptionist, Jaspreet (BM Chandigarh) and the FDM.
Sign-off principle
Sign-off requires evidence of competence, plus a final readiness test.  The final test: two to three consecutive days at Chandigarh where the trainee runs the front desk solo — greeting, bookings, calls, hospitality, billing and end-of-day — while the Senior Receptionist and FDM observe. Only when it runs cleanly is she signed off.
STREAM 1  ·  FRONT DESK FOUNDATIONS
Module 1  ·  Grooming, Professionalism & Communication
Trainer:  Senior Receptionist + FDM
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Meet the grooming and uniform standard every shift
Greet, speak and carry herself to the front-desk standard
Hold professional tone and body language under pressure
Follow front-desk discipline — no personal phone, desk tidy
Activities
Day 1: Grooming and communication assessment
Day 1: Greeting role-play
Day 2: Patient-interaction practice with feedback
Sign-off criteria
Grooming and communication to standard
Greeting and tone confident and warm
Senior Receptionist confirms readiness
STREAM 2  ·  APPOINTMENTS, CALLS & HOSPITALITY
Module 2  ·  Appointment System & Booking SOP
Trainer:  Senior Receptionist + FDM
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Book, reschedule and confirm appointments to SOP
Avoid clashes and double-booking; read the day's schedule
Locate appointments by client name
Coordinate flow with counsellor / doctor / therapist
Activities
Day 1: Booking SOP walkthrough
Day 2: Appointment-scheduling practice
Day 2: Schedule-reading and clash-avoidance exercise
Sign-off criteria
Books and confirms accurately
Reads the schedule and avoids clashes
Senior Receptionist confirms readiness
Module 3  ·  Call Handling & WhatsApp Discipline
Trainer:  Senior Receptionist
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Answer calls professionally and promptly
Run the missed-call / callback log and clear it daily
Send WhatsApp confirmations and reply within SLA
Never let an enquiry go unlogged
Activities
Day 1: Mock call-handling
Day 2: Follow-up call simulation
Day 2: WhatsApp etiquette and confirmation practice
Sign-off criteria
Calls handled professionally
Callback log understood and run
Senior Receptionist confirms readiness
Module 4  ·  Hospitality & Client Experience
Trainer:  Senior Receptionist + FDM
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Offer hospitality to every waiting client
Keep the waiting area comfortable in coordination with housekeeping
Communicate wait times honestly
Manage walk-ins without disrupting booked appointments
Activities
Day 1: Hospitality role-play
Day 2: Waiting-area and flow simulation
Day 2: Wait-time communication practice
Sign-off criteria
Hospitality standards held
Flow and waits managed calmly
FDM confirms readiness
STREAM 3  ·  BILLING, RECORDS & LIVE PRACTICAL
Module 5  ·  Billing, Records & CRM
Trainer:  Jaspreet (BM Chandigarh) + Senior Receptionist
Money and data module.  Billing and records are where trust and accuracy meet. An error here costs the client's confidence and the branch's clean books. Do not rush this module — accuracy must be habit, and off-system payments are an absolute red line.
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Bill transparently — state amount and purpose, collect, receipt
Send the WhatsApp receipt for every payment
Keep CRM and client records accurate; complete forms
Understand the absolute rule against off-system payments
Activities
Day 1: Billing SOP and system walkthrough
Day 2: Billing-accuracy exercise with mock transactions
Day 2: CRM / records hygiene exercise
Sign-off criteria
Bills accurately and transparently
Receipts sent; records accurate
Jaspreet + Senior Receptionist confirm readiness
Module 6  ·  Complaint Handling & Live Front Desk
Trainer:  FDM + Senior Receptionist
What the trainee must be able to do by end of module
Handle an early complaint calmly and escalate correctly
Collect feedback professionally
Run the live front desk under supervision
Coordinate check-in, billing and flow live
Activities
Day 1: Complaint-handling practice and escalation basics
Days 2-3: Observe and assist on the live front desk
Days 3-5: Run the front desk under supervision
Sign-off criteria
Handles a complaint calmly; escalates correctly
Runs the live desk to standard under supervision
FDM + Senior Receptionist confirm readiness
